name: cn-aigc-detector
title_zh: 五维统计信号，专挑中文AI腔的段落级检测器
tagline_zh: 句长方差、词汇TTR、结构模板、句首雷同、标点密度——五个信号交叉验证，高亮可疑段落，不靠猜。
tagline_en: Sentence-length variance, TTR, structural templates, starter uniformity, punctuation density—cross-checked to.
desc_en: Detect AI-generated Chinese text using 5 statistical signals: sentence length variance (perplexity), vocabulary TTR (burstiness), structural pattern matching (首先...其次...最后), sentence starter uniformity, and punctuation density analysis. Highlights suspicious sections. Use when: verifying if Chinese text is AI-generated, checking content authenticity before publishing, auditing user-generated conte
why_zh: 不是给整篇打分，而是逐段定位信号重叠区。把「AI味」拆成可计算的统计特征，让机器腔无处遁形。
why_en: Instead of a whole-text score, it localizes where signals overlap per paragraph. Decomposes 'AI flavor' into computable stats.
limit_zh: 只针对简体中文文本，且需≥200字才有统计意义。不识别翻译腔、混合语言或刻意模仿人类风格的AI改写。输出为高亮段落。
limit_en: Simplified Chinese only, ≥200 chars for significance. Misses translated or humanized AI text. Outputs highlights, not verdicts.
